control_rules: Before engineering resumes, read this board, PROJECT_WORK_PLAN.md and current actual source/resource ledgers. A plan entry is not permission to resume a user pause.

Identify each action/update by a stable work ID, such as WB-01.1. Use the same ID in relevant AGENT_LOG, EXPERIMENT_LOG, decision/requirement records and new evidence metadata; reference old evidence without rewriting it.

Use implement -> integrate -> focused provider-free test -> deploy -> bounded exercise -> independently verify -> fix if needed -> relevant regression -> record -> close. Use full suites at the required gates or when new changes/failures justify them, not after every unchanged observation.

Each change needs a concrete requirement/observed failure, hypothesis, bounded check, exact source and preserved result. Keep the working speech path unless an acceptance failure justifies a change. Do not repeat the completed architecture audit.

Only move a block to ACCEPTED when its exit criteria and evidence are recorded. New changes make affected evidence NEEDS_REVALIDATION; source-specific history stays intact. Define a new child ID for added work instead of renaming/erasing history.

Routine authorized project edits, checks, Pi control and transfers are autonomous. Complete setup/platform approvals before a live cue; do not interrupt the operator with permission-producing monitoring. Platform security controls still apply.

External sends/calls, consequential device/app effects and destructive/out-of-scope actions retain their applicable explicit authorization. Project setup authorization is not blanket permission to message another person.

Reconcile actual caps before provider/Piper calls, reserve startup/cues/tool rounds/cancellation costs, increase limits only under explicit applicable user authority and record the change. Never reset counters, refund failures, use hidden retries, silently switch providers or borrow the separate benchmark allowance.

Preregister every live case: work ID, candidate/config/audio setup, stimulus/expected result, pass/fail, call/effect ceilings and stopping conditions. An operator readiness click starts no audio or effect. No live execution while paused.

Preserve failed/canceled/timed-out/unstarted trial identities. A later success is a new observation. Independent readback is distinct from an action response and physical audibility is distinct from a software callback.
Keep devices/accounts/metric prerequisites and user deferrals visible. Only a recorded user-approved scope amendment changes completion obligations; unavailable or deferred capabilities are not PASS.

No arbitrary percentage or grade. Report accepted blocks and requirement coverage with limitations. Documentation, source hashes or unit tests alone do not establish full live functionality or student mastery.
Expedite: reproduce shared failures across direct tools, goal workflows, voice-shaped budgets and typed mode in provider-free tests before another live repetition.
Expedite: run focused checks during implementation and one complete regression per integrated candidate; repeat broader tests only for material changes or unresolved failures.
Expedite: batch the essential human checks; finish setup, transfers and approvals before the voice cue, preserve first-failure stopping and minimum bounded usage.

Expedite: advance independent provider-free capability work when its own prerequisites exist instead of waiting idly on hardware/accounts/operator; keep one explicit active WB ID and preserve the deployed test candidate.

Expedite: reuse project evidence/transfer tooling and standing authorization; routine project preservation is not a new human approval gate. Platform restrictions and genuine security/scope boundaries still apply.

General-purpose acceptance concerns freely worded, previously unseen user-chosen goals. Exact scripts are targeted regression checks, never the product command vocabulary or evidence of broad understanding.

Before another human check, identify the unresolved changed behavior and why existing evidence cannot answer it. Fix deterministic problems provider-free; do not automatically replay the rain/calculator or full conversation script.

Show guided-test instructions before any audio/greeting. Require explicit readiness to speak after briefing, bound to current source/protocol/counters, before starting once. A ready/acknowledgment alone starts nothing; closed attempts cannot restart.

Preserve deterministic schema, permission and consequential-action confirmation controls while ordinary intent remains model/context driven. Capability limits must be reported without forcing a request into an unrelated canned task.

Categorical authority: original assignment + COMPLETE master directive govern over every conflicting milestone, old implementation plan, local current-heading or summary. Preserve old text as history; never revive obsolete stop/advance/resource instructions.

Before choosing work, link a mandatory requirement/master section -> actual unresolved gap -> reusable outcome -> smallest implementation -> observable exit evidence. If that chain is absent, do not spend a packet on it. Logs and tests are means to the outcome, not substitute completion.

Before repeating a task/check, record what relevant code, condition or unresolved failure changed and why existing scoped evidence cannot answer it. No changed justification means reuse evidence or choose a different open outcome; no repeated full voice script, architecture audit or completed recovery task by default.

Use this board as the sole queue and requirements_registry.json as the sole requirement status registry. Update entry instructions, applicable operating docs, records and traceability at closure; do not create a competing roadmap.

Use multi-file artifact, unfamiliar-project repair, shared voice/text context and durable task outcomes explicitly. Do not narrow general-purpose completion to a command catalogue, one game or a voice conversation.

Required capability areas and course metrics stay in scope. Missing access/reference/evaluator details remain specific unresolved prerequisites; integrations named as examples require feasibility assessment, not blanket installation or automatic acceptance.

The old 31-trial dataset remains historical. Do not schedule a full rerun or inherit an old cap/sample count merely because it appears in a protocol. New evaluation needs justification, current source qualification, applicable method and fresh applicable authorization.

At every closure state the completed observable outcome, remaining mandatory gaps, next justified WB ID and actual resource usage. Refresh the current header; keep historical logs/evidence additive. User has resumed and authorized the focused Onit integration; this board-only packet launches no runtime or live check.

work_blocks.title: Natural conversation and full-duplex interaction
work_blocks.goal: Understand freely expressed conversation and unfamiliar user requests while the user participates naturally during listening, reasoning and speech; support contextual follow-ups, corrections and replacements without a fixed spoken-command catalogue.
acceptance: Natural pause handling: A pause or continuation keeps the user floor and input without prematurely completing or losing the request.
Appropriate acknowledgment handling: A genuine brief acknowledgment can suspend/resume the current response; stop, replacement and direct action confirmation are not mistaken for acknowledgments.
Interruption while speaking: Capture continues during output; a genuine takeover audibly stops obsolete playback and allows the new request.
Replacement of an existing request: The latest user replacement supersedes the remaining old request without repeating obsolete speech or dispatching abandoned steps.
Cancellation or invalidation of obsolete work: Cancel or generation-invalidate pending ASR/reasoning/tools/TTS and queued output; stale results cannot speak, execute or grant permission.

Correct treatment of already committed external actions: Cancel uncommitted work, reconcile and report committed/uncertain effects; never claim they were undone or repeat them. No new shopping write is permitted by the remaining allowance.

Context preservation and recovery: Recognized input, delivered/partial reply and relevant task state support correction/follow-up and safe recovery. Missing or over-limit audio is explicit, never invented.

Current-candidate capability coverage includes ordinary Q&A, follow-up, correction/topic change, pause, promptness, hesitation, acknowledgment, audible interruption, replacement/no replay, split and timeout recovery, clarification, confirmation boundary, read-only verification, dynamic tools and clean shutdown. Use freely worded inputs and held-out user-chosen requests; exact scripted utterances remain regression cases only.
Operator actually hears the required speech/stop/resumption; events corroborate it.
Do not treat a software callback as physical acoustic onset or assume a TTS RPC proves audible speech.
Reuse old evidence only with documented relevant-code and condition equivalence; no threshold/model change simply to force a pass.
required_evidence: Outcome-level criteria, minimal targeted live interactions for unresolved speech behavior, operator reports, unseen user-chosen requests for generalization, exact source/config/audio setup, timing boundaries and current coverage matrix. Reuse unchanged relevant evidence with documented equivalence; do not automatically replay full scripts.

Seven-behavior full-duplex matrix: exact source/config/audio, unchanged-code equivalence for historical evidence, current deterministic cancel/confirmation/commit checks and essential actual natural voice/operator observations. Fixture or transcript-only PASS does not accept physical pause/ack/interrupt/recovery. Natural user-selected content; no prescribed phrases or sequential script.

phases.name: Natural speech and conversational presentation
phases.work: Piper-first refinement under WB-02.4: improve contextual wording and phrase continuity; tune the current voice conservatively; consider one female Piper alternative only if a demonstrated gap remains. Pursue actual useful-answer latency alongside speech quality. Keep Onit/Pipecat/on-Pi VAD/student speech MCP and existing task/confirmation controls. Kokoro and automatic fixed acknowledgments are excluded. Follow piper_refinement314 steps and adoption gates; no new workstream or provider search.
phases.exit: Each claimed benefit has exact-source focused evidence and, for acoustic behavior, an owner listening comparison. Preserve complete requested content, meaningful review details, female English/Spanish voice continuity, interruption/resume, context, task outcomes and Pi resource safety. Earlier useful speech must use a separately qualified immutable validated-prefix protocol; cue audio is not substantive-answer latency. Keep F1 open while naturalness or actual timing criteria remain unsupported; unchanged accepted integrations are reused.

phases.name: Pause, directed speech and overlap behavior
phases.work: Preserve continuous listening through reasoning, speech and permitted task execution. Use general semantic/contextual interpretation for genuine interruption, listening acknowledgment, incomplete pause and speech directed elsewhere. Preserve provisional local suspension, same-answer resume, current-generation adoption and obsolete-output cancellation. Avoid phrase-list intent routing, duration-only meaning decisions and blind VAD stop-on-every-sound behavior.
phases.exit: Held-out development cases and the relevant owner exchange show appropriate pause/ignore/resume/clarification, coherent replacement and continued conversation. Current generation owns every ASR/result/audio frame; no clipped stale output or task effect is accepted. Define and later measure false/missed interruptions, premature floor takeover, acknowledgment continuation and actual output cessation separately from software cancel. Do not tune on final benchmark clips.

phases.name: Finish remaining functional gaps
phases.work: Complete recorded functional gaps through reusable Onit tools: mixed-topic voice/text task flow and return to earlier context, useful app revision, calendar readback/cancel/persistence/day planning and document criteria. Qualify command-initiated background work with explicit job state and return to conversation; started is distinct from finished. Preserve draft/recipient context without restoring authority from history. Durable continuation must cover actual interruption/timeout boundaries; broader restart claims need separate proof. Reuse accepted integrations, and keep WB08 deferred. Owner298 now prioritizes additive primary Google Calendar integration for the named account under WB-07.6; preserve local calendar and exact review/confirmation. phases.exit: Required remaining outcomes are verified or explicitly dispositioned without counting partial/deferred work as passed. A new goal may be handled while a permitted background job continues only under explicit bounded ownership, cancellation and status rules. No speculative effect, duplicate send/call, stale confirmation or unsupported completion claim. No replay of accepted task/chime/media/mail/communication checks merely to regenerate evidence.

phases.name: Benchmark bridge and method preparation

Pin course commit, audio conversion/packetization, dataset identity, seed/rounds/reset, transcription/judge/optional voice analysis, safe grants, recording and stop policy. Define and freeze the explicit timestamp, eligibility, matching and denominator contract in docs/measurement_protocol.md, distinguishing pinned-course scores from supplemental ME3 functional measures. Identify end of user speech, VAD/endpoint, ASR final, native-ready, provider dispatch/first text, validated speech commit, TTS request/first PCM and digital playout/last speech on defined clocks. Rebase the inactive bridge after runtime changes; current fixtures do not qualify a different candidate.
phases.exit: Reviewed offline adapter/cleanup/audio conversion checks pass without changing the normal Pi microphone/speaker route. Same agent and configuration lineage are explicit. Published method/prompt discrepancy is resolved with course authority or frozen and disclosed. No benchmark trial or scoring call is authorized by plan preparation. Every required metric has frozen operational definitions, labels, thresholds, clocks/alignment, missingness, scoring and uncertainty rules. Software cancellation and digital last-speech output must not be reported as physical audible cessation. Supplemental task/recovery/concurrency criteria need actual functional qualification; definitions alone are not implementation. Development timing diagnosis is not final benchmark collection. Do not equate SSE bytes, filler, TTS completion, buffer submission or software cancellation with meaningful first audible response or physical cessation. Keep official course metrics separate from supplemental task/recovery/concurrency criteria.

Build a secret-free archive and tested restore instructions without overwriting the working installation.

Retain every trial/unknown/failure/cancel/timeout and actual charges. Score and report the defined rates, timing, relevance/behavior and available voice features with uncertainty and missingness. Report the frozen precision/recall, false/missed interruption and premature-floor rates, backchannel continuation accuracy, response/stop latency distributions and eligible context/cancellation/task/recovery/concurrency outcomes, separately from official pinned-course scores.

No silent retries, sample replacement, old31-trial transfer, benchmark budget borrowing or mid-run tuning. Missing optional analysis is NOT_SCORED; required missing metrics remain incomplete. A stopped cohort stays stopped and is not mixed with a changed candidate. Report eligible n and numerators/denominators, median/p95/distributions with declared small-sample limits, suitable uncertainty, and separate missing/unscored/timeout/canceled/unstarted outcomes. No favorable-only latency population, silent imputation or undocumented exclusion; unavailable physical/required metrics remain unmeasured/incomplete.
